comparison.objective: Respond to a high-level alarm by closing an inlet while continuing a sorting task; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record emphasizes attention switching, timed valve-handle actuation and object sorting. Candidate emphasizes dexterous small-tool adjustment and iterative physical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires closure after alarm but before overflow plus correctly sorted cubes. Candidate requires two acceptable impact cycles and lock retention; rebound, overload and drift thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Timed supervisory response and multitasking are distinct from adjustment based on dynamic response.
